rawText: VIDAL-FLEURY 2020 VENTOUX VIDAL-FLEURY MAISON FONDÉE EN 1781 MARQUE DÉPOSÉE Élevé et mis en bouteille par VIDAL-FLEURY, RHÔNE, FRANCE
description: Vidal-Fleury, founded in 1781, is one of the oldest négociant-producer houses in the Rhône Valley, based in Ampuis. The Ventoux AOC lies at the southern edge of the Rhône, on the slopes of Mont Ventoux, producing predominantly Grenache-Syrah blends from limestone and clay-limestone soils. Ventoux reds are typically vinified for early-to-medium term drinking, reflecting the appellation's warm Mediterranean climate.
